profile.reading:
This is a Digital Realty facility at 6676 Northeast 62nd Avenue, Hillsboro, OR, per mapping data. Digital Realty's own property listing shows PDX12 at 5870 NE Schaaf Street, Hillsboro, OR (546,000 square feet), a different street; this address was not matched against Digital Realty's Portland metro property list this session, so no operator-confirmed square footage is reported here.

Digital Realty Trust (NYSE: DLR, SEC CIK 1297996), headquartered at 2323 Bryan Street, Dallas, Texas, reported 310 data centers worldwide as of December 31, 2025, 221 wholly owned or consolidated and 89 in unconsolidated joint ventures, about 57.6 million rentable square feet across more than 55 metro markets including 118 US facilities, per its FY2025 Form 10-K filed with the SEC. The company operates as a colocation and wholesale landlord rather than running its own compute, distinguishing it from hyperscaler tenants such as AWS, Google, or Meta, also tracked in this registry.

This building is part of Digital Realty's Portland metro footprint, concentrated in Hillsboro, a Portland suburb that also hosts major semiconductor manufacturing and, per Digital Realty's own metro page, named properties PDX10 and PDX12 along Aloclek Drive and Schaaf Street. Portland General Electric serves most of the Hillsboro data center market, and Oregon offers enterprise-zone property tax abatements that Washington County and the City of Hillsboro have used to attract large industrial and data center investment. Digital Realty markets its Portland properties under its PlatformDIGITAL brand within its global interconnection and colocation platform.

Digital Realty's FY2025 Form 10-K discloses portfolio metrics by region and metro market rather than per-building specifics for any US facility; this pattern of aggregate, not per-building, disclosure is consistent across every Digital Realty property researched by this registry this session, and is not unique to this entry.

reading.body:
Digital Realty PDX11 is a colocation facility in Hillsboro, Oregon, operated by Digital Reality Trust as part of its worldwide portfolio of 310 data centers, but the operator does not publish an IT power capacity figure for this building on its property page or in its annual SEC filings. Digital Realty discloses portfolio metrics by metro region rather than per-building, so the power envelope, rack count, and current tenant load at this address remain unknown from published sources.

Hillsboro is a Portland suburb where Oregon's enterprise-zone tax incentives have attracted significant data center and semiconductor investment, and Digital Realty operates multiple named properties there, including PDX12 at a separate address on Schaaf Street. The facility at 6676 Northeast 62nd Avenue could not be matched to an operator-confirmed property record this session, so no square footage is reported. Portland General Electric serves most of the Hillsboro data center market and would supply power to this location.

Without published megawatt capacity, this facility contributes no measurable value to estimates of Oregon's AI-relevant data center power base. Oregon has 156.6 MW of published IT capacity across eight disclosed facilities statewide, but this building is not among them. To assess whether PDX11 matters to AI scaling, operators and buyers would need to request power specifications directly from Digital Realty.
